description:
This video shows how to remove and replace plywood shower subfloors. You can visit me at homerepairtutor.com for more tips

#carpentry #showerremodel #bathroomrenovation   

Shower Subfloor Removal and Replacement Tips
1:35 Dremel Ultra Saw for plywood 
2:35 How to find floor joist locations
4:20 How to cut plywood subfloors flush against bottom plates
7:18 Floor joist adhesive removal tips
8:52 Plywood subfloor screw schedule tips
10:20 Plywood adhesive tips

These supplies were used in our video:

Dremel Ultra Saw
PL400 Adhesive
Fein MultiMaster Multi-Tool
Fein Carbide Pro Blade
